title: Candidates 2026
note: Transcribed from the page by a researcher. Township Democratic organization (party club) backing Democratic nominees. General election: ""Candidates 2026 ... Bring on the Blue Wave in Northfield Township! Support these Democratic Party candidates." ... "Please support your candidates in the 2026 election""

verify.general: yes (inferred, no date printed): the page shows no election date (only "Candidates 2026" and meta "candidates for 2026 Midterm elections"), but it lists exactly one Democratic nominee per office, all post-primary nominees on the Nov 3, 2026 Cook ballot (e.g. Daniel Biss IL-9, Patrick Hanley SD-9, Justin Cochran HD-55, Pat Hynes for Assessor, Cam Davis 2-year MWRD, judicial vacancy nominees), so the entries are clearly current for the general.
verify.note: Read the live page text. All 35 entries appear as printed and each person is on the Cook ballot for that race. Page typos left as printed: "Steven O. McKenzie" (ballot: Steven Q. McKenzie), vacancy names "Coglan" (Coghlan) and "Andreau" (Andreou); offices already set to the correct ballot races.
